CustomField.description: Cubic yards of mulch in scope for this work order. Used as the trigger condition for Scene 6B (Delivery Quality Check) in FSL Mobile — the delivery inspection fires when this field is greater than zero or Sod_Square_Footage__c is greater than zero. Also used to calculate expected mulch delivery count vs actual for the Delivery_Quality_Check__c reconciliation. Source: entered during takeoff or pulled from BMG package scope.
CustomField.label: Mulch (Cubic Yards)
